# Alburooq Smart Solutions

> Licensed ELV and smart technology integrator based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, providing CCTV, smart home automation, access control, and networking installation services.

This website provides information, buying guides, and pricing for CCTV installation, smart home automation, access control systems, intercoms, fire alarm systems, automatic gates, garage door motors, structured cabling/WiFi, and annual maintenance contracts for homes and businesses across Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE.
